model: Hamilton Khaki Field Titanium Auto H70215880
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Hamilton's official straight front render (38 mm case silhouette, listing; strap 20.3 mm against 20 mm). Heights before the house depth scale (11.45 mm thick listing). House method: modelled black PVD titanium case (one body from the traced outline), bezel and crown, black hands with lume; photo maps only for the grey dial print and the suede strap.

bezel.note: smooth black PVD bezel sloping up to the crystal

hands.note: black hands with cream lume and needle tips; black seconds hand with a lume tip

strap.note: khaki suede strap from the render, house curl from the lug tips

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: bezel, crown, index frames, hands, bevels

steel_brushed.note: house brushed steel: case, lugs, crown guards

review.subtitle: Black PVD titanium case, grey dial with lume numerals, khaki suede strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: Built on Hamilton's official 2000 px front render. House method: case, bezel, crown and hands are modelled in black; the photo is used only for the dial print and the suede strap.
The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches. The buckle is left out.
